title: Broward Trading Course
summary: Six modules that take you from 'what is a stock?' to building and backtesting your own rule-based strategy, with the paper-trading dashboard as your lab.

modules.title: Market Foundations
modules.summary: What markets are, how orders work, what moves prices, and why paper trading is the right place to start.

lessons.title: What a stock actually is
Exchanges and market hours
Reading a quote: bid, ask and the spread
Order types: market, limit and stop
Brokers, paper trading and what moves prices

modules.title: Reading Charts & Candlesticks
modules.summary: Candlesticks, timeframes, trends, support and resistance, and the classic reversal patterns, read on real chart panes.

lessons.title: Anatomy of a Candlestick and Choosing a Timeframe
Trend, Support and Resistance
Trend Lines, Channels and Volume
Classic Candlestick Patterns
Chart Patterns: Reversals and Continuations

modules.title: Technical Indicators
modules.summary: Moving averages, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, volume tools and how the dashboard combines them into a composite signal.

lessons.title: Moving averages and crossovers
Momentum oscillators: RSI and stochastic
MACD, Bollinger Bands and ATR
Trend strength and context: ADX, VWAP and Ichimoku
Combining indicators and the composite signal

modules.title: Risk Management & Paper Trading
modules.summary: Position sizing, stops, expectancy, drawdowns and the trading journal, practised on your paper account.

lessons.title: Position Sizing and the 1% Rule
Stop Losses, Risk/Reward and Expectancy
Drawdowns, Streaks and Trading Psychology
Short Selling, Margin and Leverage
Your Trading Plan, Journal and Using the Paper Account Well

modules.title: Options Basics
modules.summary: Calls, puts, premium, the Greeks, payoff diagrams and the defined-risk strategies in the options lab.

lessons.title: Calls, puts and what a premium is made of
Reading an option chain
The Greeks, intuitively, and implied volatility
Covered calls, protective puts and vertical spreads
Straddles, strangles, iron condors and assignment risk

modules.title: Strategy & Backtesting
modules.summary: Turning rules into a strategy, backtesting it honestly, avoiding overfitting and writing a trading plan you can follow.

lessons.title: What a Strategy Is: Entry and Exit Rules
Backtesting Basics and the Metrics That Matter
Why Backtests Lie: Look-Ahead, Survivorship and Overfitting
Transaction Costs and the Road to Paper Trading
Capstone: Build, Test and Paper Trade Your Own Strategy
